question: What is the space group at 0.2 Å and at 0.02 Å tolerance, and what symmetry breaks between them?

source.note: committed as one of gemma4:26b's correct answers of 2026-10-11; the raw transcript is not in the repo

text:
At a 0.2 Å tolerance, the space group is F-43m (No. 216). At a 0.02 Å tolerance, the space group is P-42_1m. The symmetry breaking between these two tolerances is the loss of the F-43m symmetry. Note that the transition from F-43m to P-42_1m occurs at 0.031 Å, which is the noise_floor_A for this run, meaning this change is within the sampling noise.
